headline: Kaiba's Best Cards
title: Kaiba's Best Cards in Yu-Gi-Oh | Top 4 Explained
video_script: Here are Seto Kaiba's best cards. Number 4: Blue-Eyes White Dragon, his signature monster with three thousand attack. Number 3: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, three Blue-Eyes fused into four thousand five hundred attack. Number 2: XYZ-Dragon Cannon, discard a card to destroy one of your opponent's cards. Number 1: and Obelisk the Tormentor, an Egyptian God with four thousand attack. Whose deck should I cover next? Comment below!

joke: Kaiba's deck has more plot armour than my whole collection.
